events.limit_basis: load dump: must stay below the 230 V output OVP (CR-04); the 10 V / 5 ms figures apply to the 12.5 A step only

textbook.basis: D from the run; dI = Vout (1-D)/(L fs); I_rms identities; I_Cin,rms = sqrt(D(Io^2+dI^2/12)-(D Io)^2); P = I_rms^2 R; P_dt = 2 t_d fs V_SD Io; ripple dI/(8 fs C)+ESR dI; input ripple dQ/C_in + ESR_in (Io+dI/2)

controller_gains.structure: outer voltage PI (V -> A) -> i_ref clamp -> inner average-current PI (A -> duty) with Vref/Vin feedforward -> duty clamp [0, 0.85] -> module comparator PWM; inductor current = i(Vld) + i(Vcout) filtered by a first-order 10 kHz low-pass (stand-in for the ePWM CTR=ZERO average sampling); output voltage through the module 20 kHz feedback filter
controller_gains.design_basis: kpi = 2 pi 4 kHz L / Vin(400 V) for an inner crossover of about 4 kHz (fs/12.5); kpv tuned by bisection on the small-signal loop gain (plant 1/(sC) || R, closed inner loop, 20 kHz filter, T/2 PWM delay) for an outer crossover of 2.3 kHz (middle of the 2.0-2.5 kHz band of design_decisions.json assumptions_accepted.voltage_loop_crossover_Hz); analytical margins are recomputed by the driver and stored in results/loop_gain_analysis.json
controller_gains.firmware_status: NO FIRMWARE EXISTS (assumptions register A-34: hardware/firmware contract only). These gains are a behavioural stand-in for the TMS320F28335 implementation and must not be copied into firmware without a discrete-time redesign (sampling, one-sample delay, ADC scaling, anti-windup, current-reference clamp coordinated with the 37.5 A OC trip).
controller_gains.iref_max_basis: 35 A: below the TMCS1133 OC trip (37.5 A, design_decisions sensing.current.oc_threshold_A) and the vendor-style I_sat 37.3 A; added assumption
controller_gains.iref_min_basis: -10 A: synchronous operation continues at no load (baseline magnetics no_load_ccm_reverse_current_A -2.8 to -3.4 A); added assumption
